problems.title: Column Settling

generationMetadata.conceptSummary: Simulate nonzero grid cells settling to the bottom of each column while preserving their order.

problems.description: You are given a nonempty rectangular integer matrix grid. A zero represents an empty cell and every nonzero integer represents a token. Independently in each column, all tokens settle toward the bottom. Their top-to-bottom relative order must remain unchanged. Return a new matrix after every column has settled. Do not modify the input matrix.
constraints: All rows have the same length

examples.explanation: Each column settles independently, and 1 remains above 4 while 2 remains above 5.

problems.title: Best Square Zone

generationMetadata.conceptSummary: Find the maximum sum among all fixed-size square regions without rescanning every cell for every region.

problems.description: You are given a nonempty rectangular integer matrix values and an integer size. Consider every size by size square whose cells lie entirely inside values. Return the greatest sum of any such square. Squares are identified by their top-left cell, and values may be negative.
constraints: All rows have the same length

examples.explanation: The bottom-right 2 by 2 square has sum 5 + 6 + 8 + 9 = 28.
